description.en: An attachment assembles from grains as it uploads, then disintegrates on failure, cancellation or removal.
description.zh: 上传时粒子逐步拼成附件，失败、取消或移除时散开。

keywords: dissolve upload tile upload tray grain attachment progress abort cancel file size error 上传 附件 瓦片 进度 粒子 取消 超限

useCases: Show attachment progress inline in a chat composer.
在聊天输入框展示附件上传进度。
discovery.caveat: 试玩模拟上传结果，接入时传入自己的文件列表和上传函数。

source.implementation: MIT-licensed dissolve upload tile and Canvas 2D grain engine, with a LeiBox attachment tray and framework adapters.

notice.en: Complete source files from this project's existing framework package. Preserve included notices and reference attribution.
notice.zh: 提供本站已有框架代码包的完整文件，保留源码声明与设计参考署名。

instructions.en: Choose a simulated result and add an attachment. Click during upload to cancel, or remove the finished tile with the cross.
instructions.zh: 选择模拟结果，再添加附件。上传中点击附件可取消，完成后可用叉号移除。
